video.title: AI欧腐《被黑帮Alpha的宝宝绑定/Bound to the Mob Alpha's Baby》
video.desc:
Cursed by a fateful night, Noah is carrying a pureblood Alpha’s child. Without daily physical contact and aura transfers from its father, the baby will drain his energy to death. Cornered, he relies on his ruthless mob-heir roommate, Cole Mercer—unaware Cole is the baby's actual father. Believing Noah was knocked up by another man, Cole’s possessive fury turns into lethal devotion. To save Noah’s life, Cole abandons his throne, while Noah signs an exile pact to save Cole. Three years later, an amnesiac Cole stumbles into Noah’s seaside shop, where his wolf instincts instantly recognize his secret son.
一场命中注定的意外之夜，让 Noah 怀上了纯血 Alpha 的孩子。
这个孩子必须每天与亲生父亲进行身体接触，并接受父亲的信息素传递，否则就会不断吸取 Noah 的生命能量，直至他力竭而亡。
走投无路之下，Noah 只能依靠自己冷酷无情的室友——黑帮继承人 Cole Mercer。然而，他并不知道，Cole 正是孩子的亲生父亲。
Cole 误以为 Noah 怀了别人的孩子，强烈的占有欲与愤怒逐渐化为足以致命的守护。为了救 Noah，Cole 不惜放弃唾手可得的黑帮王位；而 Noah 也签下流放契约，只为保住 Cole 的性命。
三年后，失去记忆的 Cole 偶然走进 Noah 开在海边的小店。尽管他什么都不记得，体内的狼族本能却在第一时间认出了那个被隐藏多年的亲生儿子。
